text: dsh-jiey-browser 是把 Jiey 浏览器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具插件。它在 Cordis 的 tools 与 systemPrompt 接口注册浏览器工具，并连接本机运行的 Jiey MCP 服务。用户可以新建标签页并查看页面快照、前进后退或重新加载、提取网页文本与链接、点击和填写页面控件、保存截图，以及列出或关闭标签页。默认隔离插件创建的标签页，不复用用户登录态；适合需要让 DSH 浏览网页、读取内容或执行页面交互的场景。使用前需安装并运行 Jiey Browser。

dsh-jiey-browser connects Jiey Browser to DeepSeek Harness over MCP. It provides tools to open tabs, navigate, read page text or links, interact with page controls, save screenshots, and manage tabs. Plugin-created tabs are isolated by default; Jiey Browser must be running.

dsh-jiey-browser 的功能「打开网页」：agent 可新建 Jiey 标签页并可选跳转到指定 URL，随后返回页面编号和可访问性快照。
dsh-jiey-browser 的功能「页面导航」：agent 可让指定标签页打开 URL、前进、后退或重新加载，并取得更新后的页面内容。
dsh-jiey-browser 的功能「读取网页」：agent 可把页面内容提取为 Markdown、纯文本或链接列表，便于阅读和整理网页资料。
dsh-jiey-browser 的功能「操作页面」：agent 可根据页面快照中的元素引用执行点击、输入、填写、按键、滚动和选择等交互。
dsh-jiey-browser 的功能「网页截图」：agent 可保存指定页面的截图到本地文件，可选 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 及整页截图。
dsh-jiey-browser 使用前须知：需要先安装并运行 Jiey Browser 的本地 MCP 服务；插件会探测本机服务端口并通过 HTTP 健康检查确认可用。
dsh-jiey-browser 使用前须知：默认不复用用户已有标签页或登录会话；只有显式启用 allowCookies 后，工具才会允许使用这些会话。

dsh-jiey-browser README · dsh-jiey-browser：DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the agent **real Jiey Browser** tools over MCP.

> Let DeepSeek Harness go online — one plugin, powered by Jiey.

DSH is in developer preview; this plugin targets the Cordis / `tools` + `systemPrompt` surface and may need updates as DSH breaks APIs.

dsh-jiey-browser README · Why Jiey (not Playwright)：| | Playwright plugins | **dsh-jiey-browser** |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime | Headless / automation profile | Real Jiey Chromium (user browser) |
| Install funnel | `npx playwright install` | Missing Jiey → download guide |
| Cookies / login | Separate profile | **Default off**; opt-in to reuse sessions |
| Cleanup | Controller close | Cordis `dispose` closes owned tabs |

dsh-jiey-browser README · Install：Requires Node.js `^22.19 || >=24` and a DSH profile.

```sh
dsh-jiey-browser README · from npm (public)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jiey-browser

dsh-jiey-browser README · or：npm install dsh-jiey-browser
```

From a local checkout after `npm run build`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/packages/dsh-jiey-browser
```

dsh-jiey-browser README · Prerequisites：Full guide: [Use with DeepSeek Harness](https://docs.browser.gongxingglobal.com/features/use-with-deepseek-harness)

dsh-jiey-browser README · Prerequisites：1. Install and open **Jiey Browser** so its MCP server is up (default `http://127.0.0.1:9100`).
   - **Download only from the official site:** https://www.gongxingglobal.com/browser  
     (macOS / Windows / Linux installers are listed there — this repo does not ship CDN links.)
2. Discovery order: plugin `serverUrl` → `BROWSEROS_URL` / `JIEY_URL` → `~/.browseros/server.json` → `http://127.0.0.1:9100`.
3. Health check: `GET /system/health` must return `{ status: "ok" }`.

dsh-jiey-browser README · Prerequisites：If Jiey is offline, tools fail with a link to the official download page (default `https://www.gongxingglobal.com/browser`) instead of silently falling back to another browser.

dsh-jiey-browser README · Configure：In the profile `cordis.patch.yml` (or DSH settings UI):

```yaml
- id: jiey-browser
  config:
    serverUrl: ""              # empty = auto-discover
    scopeId: dsh-jiey-browser  # tab isolation header

**Security:** `allowCookies` defaults to **false**. Turn it on only when the user explicitly wants the agent to use existing logged-in sites.

dsh-jiey-browser README · Tools：| Tool | Maps to Jiey MCP | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `browser_open` | `tabs` new + `snapshot` | Open |
| `browser_navigate` | `navigate` | Navigate |
| `browser_snapshot` | `snapshot` | Refs for act |
| `browser_read` | `read` | Markdown / text scrape |
| `browser_act` | `act` | click / fill / press / … |
| `browser_screenshot` | `screenshot` | Inline image (no temp file) |
| `browser_tabs` | `tabs` list/close | List / dispose |

dsh-jiey-browser README · Local smoke (no DSH)：```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm run smoke
```

With Jiey running, smoke opens `https://example.com`, snapshots, and closes the tab.
